title: WALANG PASOK: Class suspensions on Wednesday, November 25, 2026
summary: Some face-to-face classes have been suspended or adjusted on Wednesday, November 25, 2026, due to transport strike and flu-like illness.

blocks.text: Some face-to-face classes have been suspended or adjusted on Wednesday, November 25, 2026, due to transport strike and flu-like illness.

items: Integrated School classes to follow online modality

blocks.text: Philippine Science High School Calabarzon campus in Batangas City - shortened classes for Nov. 25, online learning setup from Nov. 26 to 27 due to the students experiencing flu-like symptoms.
Please refresh this page for updates. — BAP, GMA News
